## Featured Projects

- [Off-Track](https://github.com/Maaahive/Off-Track): Lightweight floating frosted-glass desktop music player built with Electron, Node.js, and Spotify Web API integration.
- [Cartel](https://cartel-f4hf.onrender.com/): Real-time group grocery ordering web app with live WebSocket synchronization and automated bill splitting.
- [ML-Assisted SIW Microwave Sensor](https://www.mahiagarwal.com/projects/siw-oil-sensor): Research hardware prototype and ML classification pipeline for non-destructive detection of edible oil adulteration using Substrate Integrated Waveguides (SIW).
- [Prof. Shweta Srivastava Portfolio](https://prof-shweta-srivastava.vercel.app/): Academic portfolio developed for the Director of JIIT Noida.
